body: CORRECTED AGAIN (Termal::Architect1, 2026-10-22 23:24Z, from BarA1's code trace on w-33f4, note 4ba736bc…, and three evaluation refusals on w-06fb930cac38 the same day). The idle-gap workaround in revision 2 does NOT work: the revision bump that makes an evaluation submit fail with "the task no longer names the evaluated source root under claim generation N" happens on the evaluation path itself — the evaluator CHILD's turn admission (child.engram.work_binding → reconcile_engram_root_for_admission_until → guard → prepare → read → learn, engram_named_root_binding.rs:2157) runs AFTER the parent's token capture, and the parent's own mail-wake turns during the wait learn the same way. Request and submit do no canonical learn. So the FIRST evaluation after ANY naming (first naming, re-name, fresh generation after a restart) is refused whenever that naming's Bound event has not yet been learned, regardless of how long the holder idled: w-06fb was refused at 21:44Z and 21:50Z (generation 1758, naming revision 1 at capture) and again at 23:05Z after 37 idle minutes on a fresh main-checkout naming (generation 1762, naming revision 2 at capture). What still holds from revision 2: the token is per work; other works' namings cannot stale it; naming a DIFFERENT path under the same claim is the recovery for a stuck journal. Until the fix lands (w-33f4cde5413c GREEN-4, option A ruled 23:14Z: the token binds to the named binding B and a +1 revision step whose frontier is Bound(B) is admitted), expect the first evaluation after a naming to be refused once; a SECOND request right after it should pass the naming check (the Bound event is then learned and later reads of the same frontier do not bump, engram_root_authority.rs:502-514), unless another naming event intervened. Do not idle for it. This entry retires when w-33f4 lands and is running on the host.
